title: Meow Supreme
subtitle: Seven patrols of everyday conquest
description: You are the cat outside the screen. Watch seven ordinary household objects from cat height and let curiosity, trouble and affection turn into one wildly exaggerated epic of conquest.

catalog.eyebrow: The first glimmer has woken up
catalog.headline: Tonight, you are the cat in this room.
catalog.description: The humans have stepped out. Seven ordinary objects are waiting for your inspection.
catalog.cardDescription: The humans have stepped out. Seven ordinary objects are waiting for your inspection.

states.label: Awe
states.description: How nervous the humans get when they find what you did

states.label: Closeness
states.description: How much your restraint and affection come through

scenes.title: The Chaos-Endless Litter Tray That Swallows All
scenes.description: The litter has just been changed and it's suspiciously smooth, as if waiting for the first pawprint.

tiers.text: You dig out today's first mountain. A few grains clear the rim, and the humans will spot your handiwork the second they get back. This time, the whole room hears it.
You dig out today's first mountain. A few grains clear the rim, and the humans will spot your handiwork the second they get back.

bite.text: You sniff the edge of the tray carefully, then decide there's nothing here worth putting in your mouth.

rub.text: You leave your scent on one corner and confirm, with some relief, that this territory is still yours.

scenes.title: The Abyss-Tipping Glass of Water at the Table's Edge
scenes.description: An ordinary half-glass of water sits near the table edge, its side catching one very suspicious highlight.

tiers.text: One light tap of your paw and the base skates across the wood; the water clearly rocks. This time, the whole room hears it.
One light tap of your paw and the base skates across the wood; the water clearly rocks.

bite.text: Glass is cold and slippery. You test the rim, then lose interest almost immediately.

rub.text: You lean in against the glass, the water trembles, and not a drop falls. The humans will only ever find a perfectly upright glass.

scenes.title: The World-Ending Slender Vase Guarding the Living Room
scenes.description: The vase stands quietly on the narrow cabinet, three small flowers swaying in the air - which gets your attention.

tiers.text: You bat at the swaying stems. The vase tips with them and stops, at the very last moment. This time, the whole room hears it.
You bat at the swaying stems. The vase tips with them and stops, at the very last moment.

bite.text: You sniff at the mouth of the vase and decide this is neither comfortable nor especially fun.

rub.text: Your cheek brushes the cold side of the vase; the petals shiver, and the vase stays exactly where it belongs.

scenes.title: The Eternal Fabric Sofa That Endures All Claws
scenes.description: Soft, wide, and the humans just said not to scratch it - there is no clearer invitation.

tiers.text: Your claws drag across the fabric and leave three brisk new lines. The humans will see them at a glance. This time, the whole room hears it.
Your claws drag across the fabric and leave three brisk new lines. The humans will see them at a glance.

bite.text: You take a corner of the cushion in your teeth. It's big and soft, and turns out to be less interesting than it looked.

rub.text: You work your way along the armrest, and the familiar smell makes the place feel more like yours.

scenes.title: The Swallowing Bedroom Closet of Hidden Realms
scenes.description: The closet isn't quite shut. A dark sliver of a gap is pretending it isn't worth investigating.

tiers.text: You slide your claws into the gap and the door swings slowly open. Inside there is only a black coat hanging down. This time, the whole room hears it.
You slide your claws into the gap and the door swings slowly open. Inside there is only a black coat hanging down.

bite.text: The handle is too high and the door is no good for biting. You decide to continue the investigation another way.

rub.text: You rub past the corner of the closet and leave a reassuring familiar smell on both sides of the door.

scenes.title: The Thunder-Serpent Charging Cable Lurking in the Corner
scenes.description: An old, already-unplugged charging cable hangs in the corner, its end swaying gently in the draught.

tiers.text: One paw pins the swaying end. It stops moving, and you lose all interest in chasing it. This time, the whole room hears it.
One paw pins the swaying end. It stops moving, and you lose all interest in chasing it.

bite.text: You bite the dead old cable and leave two shallow marks in the casing.

rub.text: You walk around the cable, do one elegant rub in the corner, and completely ignore the little swaying thing.

scenes.title: The Supreme Hand of the Can-Opener
scenes.description: The door opens. The hand that opens cans, pets heads, and occasionally produces nail clippers reaches out in front of you.

tiers.text: You press your paw pads into the human's palm without unsheathing anything, and they still freeze politely. This time, the whole room hears it.
You press your paw pads into the human's palm without unsheathing anything, and they still freeze politely.

bite.text: You hold the finger gently in your mouth and let it go at once. The human gasps, then works out you were only playing.

rub.text: You offer your forehead into the palm. The human instantly forgets most of what happened in this room.

endings.title: Meow Supreme
endings.description: You left a very clear record of your patrol - and got the humans to offer up the cans anyway. Trouble and cuteness reach a rare balance.

endings.title: Wherever You Go, Humans Tremble
endings.description: Table edges, fabric and the closet gap all carry evidence of your inspection. The humans stand in the middle of the room and start seriously reconsidering the furniture layout.

endings.title: Captivating Everyone Without Breaking Anything
endings.description: You broke almost nothing and still filled the whole home with a familiar scent. The humans open the can themselves and accept your closeness.

endings.title: Patrol Ends Here for Today
endings.description: You inspected every corner properly and decided to save the real enthusiasm for next time. After all, a nap is an important part of a cat's day.

milestones.title: The humans are hiding things
milestones.text: Fragile items are vanishing room by room. Your awe is working - a cat victory, and a human survival instinct.

milestones.title: The humans refilled the bowl
milestones.text: Fresh kibble, plus a little dish of freeze-dried treats. You only rubbed - that was enough.
